# 2.x USB Storage mode (Tracker Mini manual §13.10; Config > USB > USB Storage).
wait 300
expect-usbstorage off
# On with the script command, then Exit (F8) on the mode page.
usbstorage on
wait 100
expect-usbstorage on
screenshot ../build/sim/usb-storage-nousb.png
tap F8
wait 300
expect-usbstorage off
# On from the Config row (Config, Down x3 = USB, Right, Enter, Down = On, Apply).
tap CONFIG
tap UP
tap UP
tap UP
tap UP
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap RIGHT
tap F8
tap DOWN
tap F8
wait 100
expect-usbstorage on
# The computer mounts the drive: Exit first shows the eject reminder.
usbhost inuse
wait 100
tap F8
wait 100
expect-usbstorage on
expect-usbwarn on
screenshot ../build/sim/usb-storage-eject.png
# The computer ejects: the next Exit leaves; the Workspace reloads.
usbhost ejected
wait 100
expect-usbwarn off
tap F8
wait 300
expect-usbstorage off
# Off from the script while in use: leaves at once.
usbstorage on
usbhost inuse
wait 100
usbstorage off
wait 300
expect-usbstorage off
